name: Pixelsaver
author: Max Berggren
description: A pixel-art screensaver for Omarchy: eight scenes (embers, daylight, deep field, sumi-e, biolume, molten, hyperspace, signal corrupt) drawn from your screensaver branding, as a tiny native binary using ~1% of a core. Replaces the built-in idle service only to launch pixelsaver instead of the stock screensaver; timeouts and locking are unchanged.
